name: Task Capture
summary: Turn a spoken to-do into one markdown checkbox line and append it to your task list.

steps.prompt:
Rewrite the text below as a single markdown task line beginning with "- [ ] ". Keep it to one line. Keep the original language and the original wording wherever you can — only tidy it into a task. Do not translate, do not add details that are not there, and do not add any other lines. Reply with the task line and nothing else.

{{text}}
